snippet.title: Simple 1500 Series. Hello Kitty vol.3: Block Kuzushi. [PlayStation - TamSoft]. (2001). A-B-E-I. All.
snippet.description:
.Played By PiE. - "February 10th, 2023".
.
.PS.DataCentre. - "Hello Kitty is the best-known of many fictional characters produced by the Japanese company Sanrio. Hello Kitty is a very simply drawn character who was created in 1974 by the Sanrio Company in Tokyo, Japan. Registered in 1976, Hello Kitty is now a globally known trademark.

Simple 1500 Series Hello Kitty vol.3 Hello Kitty Block Kuzushi is a classic breakout game, in the style of the classic arcade game Arkanoid, in which the player controls hello kitty and has to destroy all the bricks in each level to advance to the next one. There are special bricks like in Arkanoid that allow the player to use speciall attack in the ball, like the slow effect, the fast attack, etc.

The game got different levels depending of the player choices (in one you go through levels of letter C and in other in levels of letter B for example), each letter is divided into 5 different brick levels. After passing a level the player unlock a picture that he can later colour in the album mode.

Manufacturer's description:
Thrills and fun galore! Break the blocks and collect the hidden items - but be sure not to drop the ball! Complete the cool Hello Kitty picture, and personalize it with the crayon and stamp tools. Single player or 2 player competition mode.

Features:
Third person perspective.
2D graphics
Cartoon graphics
Fantasy theme."
.
00:00 - Intro
00:37 - Stage A 
07:08 - Stage B
13:13 - Stage E
21:57 - Stage I
30:02 - END
.
